annotations.title: Get a download package's progress and links

description: A package's state and progress (files and bytes done, time left), and for every finished part a fresh download link valid for one hour (parts can be downloaded while later ones are still being built). States: estimating, estimated, awaiting_approval, queued, building, ready, partial (some files could not be included; see missing), failed, cancelled, rejected, expired.
name: download_status
